shapes and events after a terminal result without reset are illegal queries.

parent.change: Implemented investigate with a byte-by-byte strict UTF-8 state machine: feeds accumulate pending bytes, decode complete valid sequences and count returned code points, errors zero the failing chunk, finish errors on leftover bytes or marks finished, and reset clears all state.
